title: The calcium ion puzzle
hook: Use the numbers to build the particle picture.

doesNotKnow: How charge relates proton count to electron count.

misconception: Every ion has equal numbers of protons and electrons.
objective: Calculate electron count from proton count and charge.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: A Ca ion has 20 protons and charge +2. How many electrons does this ion have? The nucleus has 20 protons and the ion has 18 electrons. Proton charge minus electron charge gives 20 − 18 = +2. The shells show counts, not electron paths.
Concentric circles show a simplified shell count; they do not show actual electron trajectories.
Recall: An ion has 8 protons and 10 electrons. What is its charge? Eight positive charges and ten negative charges give a net charge of −2.

recall.question: An ion has 8 protons and 10 electrons. What is its charge?
recall.why: Eight positive charges and ten negative charges give a net charge of −2.
